title: Object Storage: outage review — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage outage review, approve the smaller of the remaining entitlement and the customer-claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; record eligible for a positive approved amount.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage review in this situation? Approve the smaller of the remaining entitlement and the customer-claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; record eligible for a positive approved amount.

## Hypothetical outage review amount

Assume hypothetical residual entitlement of USD 70 and a customer claim of USD 55. The assessment approves USD 55 and records an eligible decision because the approved amount is positive.
